capabilities: Select items in any modal or suggestion list with Mod plus a number key
Change the modifier key (Meta, Control, or Alt) in settings
Style the number counter transition (none, fade, slide, or permanent)
extras: Works on desktop and mobile including popout windows; requires Obsidian 0.15.0 or later. The 'Related plugins' section lists Fold Properties and Sync Folds, but they are unrelated sibling plugins.
intentEvidence: Quick Select works in every Obsidian modal and suggestion list, including the ones that open from other modals.
problem: Choosing items in Obsidian pickers requires arrow keys or a mouse, which slows down keyboard-heavy workflows.
summary: Keyboard-driven picker that lets you select items in any Obsidian modal or suggestion list by pressing Mod plus a number.
